programs.name: 3x Full Body - Low Volume Strength
programs.author: Will "Wild Odds" Dodds
programs.description: 3x Full Body run in a Low Volume Strength style. Every muscle group receives at least 6 working sets per week and no session is designed to exceed one hour. Heavy, sparse barbell strength. Squat/Bench/Deadlift/OHP driven, with accessories run heavy for low reps (1-3 sets of 1-3 reps on mains, treating accessories as heavy lifts). Built to clear the 6-set weekly floor on every muscle through compound coverage inside 60 minutes.

programs.description: 4x Full Body run in a High Volume Hypertrophy style, specialised for Lats. programs.author: Will "Wild Odds" Dodds
programs.description: 5x PPLUL run in a High Volume Powerbuilding style. Every muscle group receives at least 6 working sets per week and no session is designed to exceed one hour. High-volume strength front half (heavy top sets plus back-offs) blended with high-volume hypertrophy isolation using intensity techniques on the back half.

exercises.notes: complete 100 reps for time | break into mini-sets as needed, keep the clock running

exercises.name: Pec Squeeze
exercises.notes: hold a hard peak squeeze 2-3 s each rep | rest 75 s

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.notes: flye to failure | rest 75 s

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: target 2 reps | heavy top set | rest 3 min

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: target 5-6 reps | back-off volume | rest 2 min

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
